p7_b0.ocr: In recent years, the telecommunications sector in Europe has witnessed significant shifts in revenue streams, particularly in roaming revenue trends, enterprise connectivity revenue, and IoT connection growth. The data presented in the accompanying table highlights these trends, revealing a robust increase in roaming revenue from €150M in 2020 to a remarkable €300M by 2022.

p7_b1.ocr: This surge correlates with a calculated GrowthRate of 20%, indicating a vigorous recovery post-pandemic. Furthermore, enterprise connectivity revenue has shown consistent growth, with a notable increase of €22M from the previous year.
